scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Elixir module and pattern matching
checks.code:
defmodule Museum do
 def area({:rectangle, w, h}), do: w * h
end
IO.puts(Museum.area({:rectangle,3,4}))

checks.name: Elixir process message passing
checks.code:
parent = self()
spawn(fn -> send(parent, {:result,7*7}) end)
receive do {:result,n} -> IO.puts(n) end

checks.name: Elixir multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: Enum.each(1..2, fn _ -> line = IO.read(:stdio, :line); IO.puts("[" <> String.trim_trailing(line, "\n") <> "]") end)

result.stderr:
** (TokenMissingError) main.exs:2:1: missing terminator: end (for "do" starting at line 1)
    (elixir 1.14.0) lib/code.ex:1245: Code.require_file/2

checks.name: Elixir handled exception succeeds
checks.code: try do raise "expected" rescue RuntimeError -> IO.puts("handled") end

checks.name: Elixir missing package fails without restore

result.stderr:
** (ArgumentError) could not load module Museum.Missing due to reason :nofile
    (elixir 1.14.0) lib/code.ex:1624: Code.ensure_compiled!/1
    (elixir 1.14.0) lib/code.ex:1245: Code.require_file/2

checks.name: Elixir timeout
checks.code:
defmodule Spin do
 def go, do: go()
end
Spin.go()
